name: Ticagrelor
sections: White to off-white crystalline powder, practically insoluble in water.

The PLATO trial (2009; 18,624 ACS patients) showed reduced vascular death, MI and stroke versus clopidogrel; PEGASUS-TIMI 54 supported 60 mg twice daily long-term after MI. First approval/introduction: EU December 2010; US FDA July 2011 (AstraZeneca).

Direct-acting, reversible allosteric antagonist of the platelet P2Y12 receptor (no metabolic activation required), giving faster and more consistent platelet inhibition than clopidogrel; also inhibits adenosine reuptake. Receptor / target profile: Reversible, allosteric P2Y12 antagonist that does not require metabolic activation; also inhibits ENT1 adenosine reuptake.
Hepatic CYP3A4 to equipotent active metabolite AR-C124910XX
Summary: Bioavailability ~36%; Tmax ~1.5 h. >99% protein bound. Metabolised by CYP3A4 to an active metabolite. Half-life ~7 h (metabolite ~9 h); twice-daily dosing.
Acute coronary syndrome (unstable angina, NSTEMI, STEMI) – with aspirin, managed medically or with PCI/CABG
History of MI (≥1 year) with high risk of atherothrombotic events (60 mg strength)
ACS: loading 180 mg, then 90 mg twice daily with aspirin 75–100 mg/day for 12 months
Prior MI: 60 mg twice daily after initial 1-year therapy
Can be crushed and dispersed in water
Dose to be individualised by the treating physician according to clinical response and tolerability.
No adjustment (avoid in dialysis – limited data).
Concomitant strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (ketoconazole, clarithromycin, ritonavir)
Bleeding – stop 5 days before elective surgery
Aspirin maintenance dose must not exceed 100 mg/day
Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors – contraindicated; strong inducers (rifampicin) – avoid
With or without food; avoid grapefruit.
Bleeding; uric acid; dyspnoea; heart rhythm.
Bleeding, ventricular pauses. Supportive care; not dialysable; platelet transfusion unlikely to help.
PLATO (Wallentin et al., NEJM 2009) – reduced vascular death, MI and stroke versus clopidogrel in ACS.
PEGASUS-TIMI 54 (NEJM 2015) – 60 mg BD reduced events after prior MI.
THALES (NEJM 2020) – ticagrelor + aspirin reduced stroke/death after minor stroke/TIA.
Take twice daily – do not miss doses
Mild breathlessness is common – report if severe
Store below 30°C in a dry place, protected from light and moisture. Keep out of the reach of children. Do not use after the expiry date.
